Character Designer:
The first character is the photographer Li Qiang, a young and promising individual skilled at capturing the details and emotions of life. He comes to the small town in search of inspiration but gets inadvertently involved in a murder case. Li Qiang's motivation is to uncover the truth behind a Taiwanese myth, and he harbors a secret that he once witnessed a mysterious ritual in the backyard of a café. He shares a subtle connection with the mysterious old man as the old man highly praises his photography work.

The second character is the old man Zhang Ming, a mysterious and eccentric diviner with the ability to foresee the future. He is well-versed in Taiwanese mythical legends, but his secret is that he once predicted a murder case would occur at the café. He has a complicated relationship with a young woman who sought his help to break a family curse.

The third character is the woman Chen Yu, a folklorist who delves deep into researching traditional Taiwanese culture. Her investigation plays a crucial role in the murder case, but her secret is that she is actually a descendant of an important figure in Taiwanese mythology. She has an inexplicable connection with the arrival of the outsider because the outsider seems to have some knowledge about her heritage.

The final character is the outsider Wang Hao, shrouded in mystery, who raises the suspicion of the town residents. His motivation is to find a family heirloom lost for years, and his secret is that he has no connection to the murder case but has unwittingly stumbled into the conspiracy. He has a subtle connection with the photographer as he once met the photographer's father in another place.

The background stories, motivations, secrets, and relationships of these four characters are intricately intertwined, injecting deeper soul and complexity into the story. Their respective secrets and purposes gradually come to light, unveiling the truth behind the mysterious legends of the Taiwanese island. The whole story is filled with suspense and emotional conflicts, immersing players in this world full of mysterious charm.

1. Round One: Self-introduction of Characters and Preliminary Case Discussion
   - Time: 30 minutes
   - Content: Each character introduces their identity and motives, briefly discusses the case background and clues.

2. Round Two: Collecting Clues Provided by Other Players
   - Time: 40 minutes
   - Content: Each character actively interacts with other characters, collects clues provided by other players, and carefully analyzes the credibility and importance of each clue.

   - Time: 50 minutes
   - Content: In the discussion, each character engages in reasoning and discusses various details of the case, guiding other players to delve into the truth of the case.

   - Time: 40 minutes
   - Content: Each character reviews the clues from the previous rounds to see if there are any omissions or overlooked information, and shares their findings with other players to collectively advance the investigation of the case.

   - Time: 30 minutes
   - Content: Each character, based on all collected clues and discussion content, carefully considers and then votes for the character they believe is the true culprit.

- The time for each round can be adjusted based on the actual situation to ensure that the game process is not affected by insufficient time.
- The host can flexibly determine the time allocation for each round based on the interactions between characters to ensure the smooth progress of the game.

- The host should remind players of the time before the end of each round to ensure that the game process proceeds as planned.
- Before the final round of voting to identify the culprit, the host should remind players to comprehensively analyze the clues to make the final decision.
